style: true pixel art sprite, 16-bit era RPG, about 64 pixels tall, strict pixel grid, 1-pixel dark outline, ~16 colors, flat 2-3 tone shading, no anti-aliasing; anime bishoujo, SD chibi 2.5-3 heads; full body, 3/4 view facing right; fully transparent background, no glow, no shadow; no text. Same art style as the attached reference character, but a clearly different person.
